bias.en: Downtrend · broke $1,300, testing the March low
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $1,300，测试 3月低点

read.en: ASML fell 6.6% on Nov 20 to $1,266.22, its lowest close since Mar 30, trading $1,258.70–1,336.76 on heavy volume (1.87x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($1,361.5), 10-day ($1,435.5), 30-day ($1,544.9), 100-day ($1,681.8) and 200-day ($1,601.5), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($1,551.01), and RSI is 28.8, oversold.

The drop broke the $1,351.8–1,355 (Nov 5, 17 and 19 lows) and $1,300 supports, now resistance, and the close is just above the Mar 30 low. Resistance is $1,272–1,291 (April and March lows), then $1,300–1,316 and $1,337–1,355. Support is $1,248–1,259 (Mar 30 and Nov 20 lows), then $1,176 (Jan 8 low) and $1,141.7. A close above $1,291 would target $1,300–1,316; below $1,248, $1,176.
